articles.title: No Gold, No Trips: Why India's PM Wants You to Stay Home
articles.summary: Imagine your parents saying no vacations and no gold jewelry for a whole year. That's what India's PM Modi is asking everyone to do because a war far away is making fuel and food super expensive.

articles.title: Shhh! France's President Tells a Whole Room to Be Quiet
articles.summary: Imagine your teacher stopping class to tell everyone to stop talking. That's what French President Macron did at a big meeting in Africa—he grabbed the mic and told the crowd they were being disrespectful.

articles.title: UK's Leader in Trouble: Can a Promise to Europe Save Him?
articles.summary: Britain's Prime Minister Keir Starmer is in hot water after his party lost big in local elections. Now he says he'll move the UK closer to Europe to fix things—but some people in his own party want him to quit.
